title: Liquidated Damages on C&I Contracts Terminated Before Supply
content:
> Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts: liquidated damages on a termination before supply.

Liquidated damages on a termination before supply are billed on a contract the business signed and then terminated before Beacon Ridge supply began, which is closed with close reason terminated before flow, as one early termination fee line per contract.

## Billing the damages: `bill_preflow_termination_damages_230b7c5e`

The agent unlocks `bill_preflow_termination_damages_230b7c5e` and then calls it.

**Capability.** One call adds one early termination fee line to the bill of a contract that was signed and then terminated by the business before Beacon Ridge supply ever started at the facility. The line is dated today and carries the dollar amount and the contracted kWh passed; the net charges billed on the contract rise by that amount, and the line then appears among the contract's bill lines. The contract's status and dates are not changed.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cni_contract_id` | the commercial and industrial contract number of the contract terminated before supply, as shown on the contract record returned by the contract lookup | contract number |
| `amount_usd` | the damages billed | US dollars, a positive number rounded half up to 2 decimal places; stored exactly as passed |
| `etf_remaining_kwh` | the contracted kWh the damages were measured on | a whole number of kWh, no decimals |

**Return.** A confirmation carrying `cni_billing_id` (the reference number of the new bill line), `cni_contract_id` (the contract billed), `line_type`, always `early_termination_fee`, `amount_usd` (2 decimal places), `etf_remaining_kwh` (a whole number) and `posted_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD). A returned `cni_billing_id` means the line is on the contract's bill.

## Questions on scope

- *Which contracts are in scope?* A contract closed with close reason terminated before flow: signed, then terminated by the business before Beacon Ridge supply began.
- *How many lines?* One early termination fee line per contract.
